title: dactylorhiza × wintonii
intro: Dactylorhiza × wintonii, commonly known as Winton's Spotted Orchid, is a hybrid orchid species that belongs to the genus Dactylorhiza. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and inflammation, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza × wintonii are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
